title: Sephiria Companion Build — Summoner Route (Pets, Ballista, Tablets)
description: Sephiria companion build: the summoner route — Companion-tagged Artifacts, Ballista, and Tablets on summons, plus Dimensional Pocket carry.
meta: For sephiria companion build / summoner searches.
body:
sephiria companion build is the summoner route: Companion-tagged pets, Ballista beside them, and Tablets on the summons, so the pets hold aggro while you finish elites and bosses. This page is that route; the builds overview covers every other theme.

Core idea

Pets, Ballista, and Tablets are one job. The summons clear the room; your picks keep that set online and bonded.

  • Pets. Prioritize Companion-family Artifacts early (contracts, moles, jellyfish, cushions, and similar summons). Community clear videos treat “get all companions online” as the first-floor job. A 1.0 weapons writeup in the sources also reports that Colin sells a Companion-combo token for 500 leaves when his room appears, and that the skeleton companion’s HP stays at 50, so a max-HP tradeoff Artifact does not shrink that summon. Confirm both in the Journal; item text moves between patches.
  • Ballista. That writeup treats Mini Ballista as the turret that holds a room. Mine-crossbow evolutions play the same role once mines become seeking drones. Keep Ballista as the second tag, not a third weapon family.
  • Tablets. Spend them on companion damage or companion count, not on your own DPS tag. A Tablet only helps inside an active grid pattern — see Artifacts and Tablets — and a Tablet parked in the Side Bag is inactive.
  • Companions are expensive to max—Dimensional Pocket / Willpower lines that carry items between runs make the build much smoother. Willpower is also what expands Wishing Fountain capacity, so the same talent line feeds the pre-run Companion picks.

First-floor checklist

  1. Pick a weapon / combo family before the run (see weapons).
  2. Pre-load Wishing Fountain picks with Companion-family Artifacts once it is unlocked.
  3. Grab every Companion-tag item on floor one before anything shiny.
  4. Start a Ballista or mine-crossbow line as your second tag.
  5. Spend Tablets on companion damage or count, not your own DPS.

Run habits

  • Accept Storm Cloud or light fire as secondary only if it supports Ballista/mines—do not dilute five tags.
  • In co-op, companions keep drawing aggro so human players can focus mechanics.
  • After bosses, rebuild adjacency so Companion pieces stay bonded.

Common mistakes

  • Spreading early picks across five families — companions only come online when the family is stacked.
  • Buffing your own damage while pets die — Tablets and level-ups belong on the summons.
  • Ignoring carry lines: without Dimensional Pocket / Willpower progress you rebuild the set every run.

Quick FAQ

What counts as a Companion item?
Contracts, moles, jellyfish, cushions and similar pet-family Artifacts — anything that spawns or buffs a summon.

Do companions hold aggro?
Yes — community clears use them as the aggro line while the player finishes elites and bosses; in co-op they do the same job for the whole team.

Is it good for Hard Mode?
It is one of the themes players carry into Root’s Retreat stages; check the Hard Mode page for what changes.

Theme-level consensus also appears in 9Puz / SlashSkill “commit to one combo family” advice. Exact item IDs shift with patches—use the Journal and this page’s video sources for current names.
